[[File:Mercenary_Pilots_Jacket.jpg|thumb|250px|A mercenary pilot's jacket recovered by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] following the battle to free Azzameen Station]]
A group of '''mercenaries''' operated some time before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. The group used the [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] facility [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]]&mdash;designated "Falcon's Nest" under [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] control&mdash;as their base of operations as they [[Mission to meet Bothan delegation|worked against]] the forces of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The mercenary group was eventually removed from Falcon's Nest by a joint [[Battle of Azzameen Station|effort]] between the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and the [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] former owners, the [[Azzameen family]].
